segments.contextBefore: Refer to [`TaskGroup`](taskgroup.md) documentation for detailed discussion of semantics shared between all task groups.
segments.contextAfter: You can cancel a task group and all of its child tasks by calling the [`cancelAll()`](taskgroup/cancelall().md) method on the task group, or by canceling the task in which the group is running.

segments.contextAfter: If you call `addTask(priority:operation:)` to create a new task in a canceled group, that task is immediately canceled after creation.

segments.contextBefore: You can cancel a task group and all of its child tasks by calling the [`cancelAll()`](taskgroup/cancelall().md) method on the task group, or by canceling the task in which the group is running.
segments.contextAfter: Alternatively, you can call `asyncUnlessCancelled(priority:operation:)`, which doesn’t create the task if the group has already been canceled.

segments.contextAfter: Choosing between these two functions lets you control how to react to cancellation within a group: some child tasks need to run regardless of cancellation, but other tasks are better not even being created when you know they can’t produce useful results.
